usage_zh: 网站导航、favicon、加载占位、应用内品牌标识
art_direction_zh: 复用已批准的樱花粉猫耳数字9原始矢量；核对小尺寸边缘与透明留白
art_direction_en: Use the exact approved sakura-pink cat-eared numeral-nine mark. Do not redraw or approximate it with an image model.
motion_design_zh: 静态优先；不自动添加装饰动画

usage_zh: 官网页眉、登录页、产品页脚及深色背景品牌签名
art_direction_zh: 复用已批准猫耳9＋mew＋九喵排版；品牌图形樱花粉，字标采用已批准深浅主题颜色
art_direction_en: Preserve the approved nine-mark and mew/Chinese wordmark geometry, spacing and typography. Theme adaptation must use the real master artwork.
motion_design_zh: 静态优先；不自动添加装饰动画

usage_zh: 应用图标、PWA、桌面安装与下载卡
art_direction_zh: 复用简洁猫耳9；遵守各平台安全区域，透明/实底版本分别核验
art_direction_en: Prepare platform icon exports from the approved master mark with verified safe-area padding; no invented icon geometry.
motion_design_zh: 静态优先；不自动添加装饰动画

usage_zh: Open Graph、分享封面、公告封面
art_direction_zh: 无文字星空猫群背景，留稳定标题安全区；品牌字标由前端或矢量排版叠加
art_direction_en: An elegant miniature cat sanctuary among softly luminous stars, with a clean negative-space zone for later real typography, no lettering inside the image.
motion_design_zh: 静态优先；不自动添加装饰动画

usage_zh: 奶喵主角色、官网官方喵灵、角色风格母版
art_direction_zh: 奶白色猫，樱花粉耳内与肉垫，清澈眼神，真实猫关节和优雅坐姿；同一身份跨视角保持一致
art_direction_en: A single elegant cream-white kitten mascot with subtle sakura-pink inner ears and paw pads, expressive clear eyes, feline muzzle and believable soft anatomy. Premium tactile stylized 3D, graceful seated silhouette, coherent front/side/back identity.
motion_design_zh: 先静态定型；真实3D版本复用下方动作片段

usage_zh: 协作与社区的布偶猫配角
art_direction_zh: 海豹双色布偶猫，蓝眼、柔软长毛轮廓、白手套；亲和优雅，不与奶喵同模换色
art_direction_en: An elegant seal-bicolor ragdoll cat with blue eyes, a soft long-haired silhouette and white paws, anatomically distinct from the primary cream kitten; calm graceful pose.
motion_design_zh: 低频眨眼或抬头

usage_zh: 协作与探索场景的缅因猫配角
art_direction_zh: 暖橘虎斑缅因猫，耳簇、长尾、较长四肢；体态稳重，橘色是毛色而非独立品种
art_direction_en: A warm ginger-tabby Maine Coon with ear tufts, a long plume tail and elegant longer limbs; a confident gentle teammate, genuine breed-specific silhouette.
motion_design_zh: 轻微尾摆或伸展

usage_zh: 知识、条款与安静陪伴的英短配角
art_direction_zh: 蓝灰色英国短毛猫，琥珀眼、圆脸、厚密短毛，体型饱满但不球形
art_direction_en: A blue-gray British Shorthair with amber eyes, rounded cheeks and a dense short coat; a grounded feline body rather than a featureless sphere, thoughtful gentle expression.
motion_design_zh: 缓慢眨眼或呼吸

usage_zh: 注册预选头像、成员列表、群聊与个人档案
art_direction_zh: 核对现有猫咪头像目录、重复项、ID、授权、版本、缩略图与深浅底适配；134条为待核验目录计数，不等于134个品种
art_direction_en: Audit the existing cat-avatar catalog before generating anything. Preserve stable catalog IDs and versions; do not claim 134 verified entries or breeds without evidence.
motion_design_zh: 只为已批准且有实际需求的头像提供可停用轻动作

art_direction_zh: 一群不同品种的猫在安静浩瀚星海中的柔软浮岛上嬉戏、相伴；留出标题区，群体关系清晰
art_direction_en: A beautifully designed sanctuary of several different cat breeds playing and resting on soft floating islands in a vast gentle cosmos; clear story focus and generous negative space for a website headline.
motion_design_zh: 尾巴、耳朵、星光和缓慢视差；主角真实动作优先，静帧平移只标注为动效海报

art_direction_zh: 猫咪协作完成一座微型星桥，角色、任务和成果自然可读，不画假界面
art_direction_en: A small team of distinct cats naturally cooperating to assemble an elegant miniature star bridge, with a tangible shared result; no fake product interface.
motion_design_zh: 猫咪传递一块构件，构件有真实接触与落位

art_direction_zh: 三只不同品种的猫在模块化圆形工作台协作，各有明确位置和分工；精致少量道具
art_direction_en: Three distinct cats collaborating around a refined modular circular worktable, each with a clear role and personal space; restrained carefully designed tactile props.
motion_design_zh: 轮流提交小构件，避免所有角色同时乱动

art_direction_zh: 奶喵邀请访客触碰一颗柔亮星球，姿态有好奇和欢迎感，不伪造可点击按钮
art_direction_en: The cream kitten inviting the viewer to gently explore a softly glowing star sphere, curious and welcoming, with a clear open composition and no baked-in buttons.
motion_design_zh: 轻抬爪、星球回应；交互仅在真实可用时连接功能

art_direction_zh: 猫咪沿着书页般柔软阶梯探索，暖光引导路径；书脊空白，适合中英叠字
art_direction_en: A curious kitten exploring gentle page-like steps in a luminous miniature reading garden, a warm light guiding the route, blank book surfaces.
motion_design_zh: 翻一页、看向下一阶，不让长循环干扰阅读

art_direction_zh: 猫咪安坐半透明圆弧玻璃花房，帘幕与入口形成有边界的安静空间；不堆盾牌锁头
art_direction_en: A serene cat in an elegant curved translucent-glass garden alcove, with soft curtains and a clearly bounded entrance; a warm visual metaphor for a private space, no generic shield or padlock collage.
motion_design_zh: 帘幕轻摆、猫咪安心眨眼；默认静态

art_direction_zh: 两只猫在一条共享小径旁停步相望，一本精致空白册子和整齐踏石表达约定与秩序
art_direction_en: Two elegant cats calmly sharing a small pathway, a beautifully crafted blank open booklet and neatly arranged stepping stones suggesting mutual understanding and clear boundaries.
motion_design_zh: 轻点头、翻一页；不做签署成功或法律承诺动画

usage_zh: 认识九喵、团队与品牌故事
art_direction_zh: 不同品种猫围成松弛自然的小群体看向同一片星空；温暖有探索欲
art_direction_en: Several visibly different cat breeds gathered in a relaxed natural group, looking toward a shared starry horizon; warm companionship and quiet curiosity.
motion_design_zh: 呼吸、尾摆和目光交流

usage_zh: 混合群聊空态、协作功能介绍
art_direction_zh: 两名人类身份用抽象非肖像小座位表示，两个猫Agent在共同工作台协作；不画真实聊天文字
art_direction_en: A refined miniature collaboration table with two non-portrait human presence markers and two distinct cat agents, visually equal participation and shared space; no readable chat text.
motion_design_zh: 有序轮流回应、交接任务，不能暗示真实消息已发送

art_direction_zh: 英短猫在柔和环形书架边分类整理空白册子，来源路径用少量细线表达
art_direction_en: A thoughtful blue-gray British Shorthair organizing beautiful blank volumes beside a gently curved library shelf, a few subtle source-path threads, quiet coherent props.
motion_design_zh: 抽取一本书、放回标记位置

art_direction_zh: 猫咪连接几颗精致陶瓷星点，线条轻细、前后层级明确；仅作插画不承载精确信息
art_direction_en: A cat gently arranging a small constellation of ceramic star nodes connected by delicate threads, refined depth and clear silhouette; editorial illustration, not a precise data diagram.
motion_design_zh: 一条连接缓慢点亮；真实图数据由产品组件渲染

art_direction_zh: 猫咪在精致工具抽屉中选择一件小工具，工具尺度与爪子匹配
art_direction_en: An elegant kitten selecting one carefully crafted small tool from a tidy rounded drawer, tactile coherent materials and believable paw-to-tool scale.
motion_design_zh: 选取、检查、放回，不演示未获准脚本执行

usage_zh: 技能市场介绍与未上线占位
art_direction_zh: 温暖小型展示台上整齐摆放可复用组件，猫咪交流；没有钱袋、销量或购买成功标记
art_direction_en: A warm miniature display gallery of refined reusable components with two cats exchanging ideas; no prices, sales claims, money bags or purchase-success symbols.
motion_design_zh: 转动展示件，购买与结算反馈由真实状态触发

art_direction_zh: 猫咪面对有留白的画布与精致色片，画笔按猫爪合理抓握或搭靠
art_direction_en: A graceful cat beside a clean blank canvas and a few beautifully designed color chips, natural paw interaction and restrained studio props.
motion_design_zh: 轻触色片，画布出现抽象色光而非伪造成品

art_direction_zh: 猫咪推动几张无文字分镜卡顺序展开，镜头框作为柔和造型而非假编辑界面
art_direction_en: A cat unfolding a small sequence of blank storyboard cards in a beautiful miniature studio; elegant motion-design tools without a fake video-editor UI.
motion_design_zh: 分镜依次展开、首尾归位，输出状态不由动画决定

art_direction_zh: 几只猫停靠在轻盈星港，五条柔和通路表达分发方向；不嵌入平台商标或假下载按钮
art_direction_en: A graceful cat starport with a small group of cats and five subtle departure paths, refined floating docks and quiet cosmic light; no platform logos or download buttons.
motion_design_zh: 小星船缓慢靠站，下载按钮只由真实注册表生成

usage_zh: 金融板块申请与未上线说明
art_direction_zh: 安静的猫咪天文观测台，入口帘幕尚未开启；不画上涨收益曲线或现金
art_direction_en: A quiet feline observatory with a refined entrance curtain still closed, careful instruments and a calm horizon; no rising profit chart, money pile or promise of returns.
motion_design_zh: 仪器轻微调整；保持清楚未上线标识由HTML提供

art_direction_zh: 奶喵在柔软月牙形小窝中抬头相望，陪伴感明确；不用付费抽蛋或稀有度诱导
art_direction_en: The cream kitten looking up from an elegant crescent-shaped cozy nest, inviting gentle companionship; no paid loot eggs, rarity badges or purchase pressure.
motion_design_zh: 呼吸、抬头、轻挥爪

art_direction_zh: 不同品种和幻想外观的猫在安静星园相聚，公共空间有边界和余地
art_direction_en: Distinct cat breeds and a few tasteful fantasy coats meeting in a calm celestial garden, ample personal space and friendly natural feline gestures.
motion_design_zh: 受限结伴小动作，不表现无限自动聊天

usage_zh: 星轨档案与成长树空态
art_direction_zh: 奶喵沿温柔发光的小径回望几颗记忆星点；实际事件节点由产品绘制
art_direction_en: The cream kitten looking back along a softly luminous path with a few memory-like stars; a quiet personal journey illustration, leaving actual milestones for the product interface.
motion_design_zh: 一颗获准里程碑星点亮起；不自动虚构进化记录

usage_zh: 九条命品牌故事、九星域及星旅九章
art_direction_zh: 统一角色的九星域故事视觉家族，先逐章分镜再制作；主题不覆盖已批准品牌正史
art_direction_en: A coherent nine-chapter feline cosmic story world, with one stable protagonist and distinct beautiful star realms; each chapter has a purposeful action and emotional beat, not nine interchangeable planets.
motion_design_zh: 先制作分镜与关键姿态，再按章生成真实镜头；不将平移海报称完整角色动画
